title: Serve
description: config.ini [Serve] section (ServeConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

host.description: Hostname to bind serve mode RPC servers to.

port.description: TCP port for single-potential or replicated serve mode.

replicas.description: Number of replicated server instances. In gateway mode, this is the pool size.

gateway_port.description: If > 0, start a single gateway on this port backed by a pool of 'replicas' potential instances dispatched round-robin. Set to 0 to disable gateway mode.

endpoints.description: Multi-model serve spec: comma-separated 'potential:port' or 'potential:host:port' entries. When set, overrides single-potential serve.
